name: github-ghclone
description: Auto-rotating GitHub acceleration for China: ghclone script + git insteadOf + alias, with per-prefix retry

scripts.selftest: for p in https://gh-proxy.com https://ghfast.top https://ghproxy.net; do echo "$p -> $(git ls-remote "$p/https://github.com/octocat/Hello-World.git" HEAD 2>/dev/null | head -1 || echo down)"; done
